title: Lamar Jackson has another full practice on Thursday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Lamar Jackson has another full practice on Thursday
sources.description: Accurate predictions about whether Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will return to action from an ankle injury have been tough to come by in recent weeks, but it's looking a lot like this will be the week.
